title: Migration 34 — farmer access requests
description: Applies migration 34 standalone and rolls it back, scoring VERIFY sections A-F. 34 fixes a defect observed on the live site: the public supplier-signup form wrote the applicant's details to their own browser storage and routed them to a dashboard requiring a session the form never created, so nothing reached the business. It introduces a real intake table. The rollback therefore removes a table that in production would hold genuine applicant rows -- the symmetry check confirms it removes the structure, not that anyone should run it.
